items.source: When this flag is set to true, supportsMimeType(MessageHeaders) will return false if the contentTypeResolver is not defined or if no content-type header is present.
items.translation: 当此标志设置为 `true` 时，如果未定义 contentTypeResolver 或不存在 Content-Type 标头，supportsMimeType(MessageHeaders) 将返回 `false`。

items.source: Note: if the resolver is set to null, then strictContentTypeMatch should be false, which is the default, or otherwise this converter will ignore all messages.
items.translation: 注意：如果解析器设置为null，则strictContentTypeMatch应设为false（即默认值），否则此转换器将忽略所有消息。

items.source: A converter can be configured to be strict only when a contentTypeResolver is configured and the list of supportedMimeTypes is not empty.
items.translation: 转换器仅在配置了contentTypeResolver且supportedMimeTypes列表不为空时，可被配置为严格模式。

items.source: By default, this returns the first element of the supportedMimeTypes, if any. Can be overridden in subclasses.
items.translation: 默认情况下，如果存在该元素，则返回 supportedMimeTypes 的第一个元素。可在子类中重写此方法。

items.source: By default, a DefaultContentTypeResolver instance is used.
items.translation: 默认情况下，使用一个DefaultContentTypeResolver 实例。

items.source: If the converter does not support the specified media type or cannot perform the conversion, it should return null.
items.translation: 如果转换器不支持指定的媒体类型或无法执行转换，它应返回null。

items.source: The default value is byte[].
items.translation: 默认值为 byte[]。

items.source: Abstract base class for SmartMessageConverter implementations including support for common properties and a partial implementation of the conversion methods, mainly to check if the converter supports the conversion based on the payload class and MIME type.
items.translation: `SmartMessageConverter` 实现的抽象基类，包括对通用属性的支持以及转换方法的部分实现，主要用于根据负载类和 MIME 类型检查转换器是否支持该转换。

items.source: A variant of MessageConverter.fromMessage(Message, Class) which takes an extra conversion context as an argument, allowing to take, for example, annotations on a payload parameter into account.
items.translation: 这是 `MessageConverter.fromMessage(Message, Class)` 的一个变体，它接受一个额外的转换上下文作为参数，从而可以例如考虑负载参数的注解。

items.source: Configure a ContentTypeResolver for resolving the content type of input messages.
items.translation: 配置一个 `ContentTypeResolver` 以解析输入消息的内容类型。

items.source: Configure the preferred serialization class to use (byte[] or String) when converting an Object payload to a Message.
items.translation: 配置在将 Object 负载转换为Message时使用的首选序列化类（byte[] 或 String）。

items.source: Whether this converter should convert messages for which no content type can be resolved through the configured ContentTypeResolver.
items.translation: 此转换器是否应转换无法通过配置的 ContentTypeResolver 解析出内容类型的消息。

items.source: A variant of MessageConverter.toMessage(Object, MessageHeaders) which takes an extra conversion context as an argument, allowing to take, for example, annotations on a return type into account.
items.translation: 这是 `MessageConverter.toMessage(Object, MessageHeaders)` 的一个变体，它接受一个额外的转换上下文作为参数，从而可以例如考虑返回类型上的注解。

items.translation: 允许子类添加更多支持的 MIME 类型。
